note: Shared entries for the three Realm of Chaos armies (chaos-warriors, chaos-beastmen, chaos-daemons). Those files set the categories, limits and rules and point here with "base".
source: Warhammer Armies: Realm of Chaos (5th edition), army lists pp.96-120 (book page numbers)
keywordsSource: Special rule keywords from the Realm of Chaos army lists

entries.name: Champion of Chaos
entries.equipmentText: Sword, axe, club or other hand weapon
entries.notes: May ride a chariot from his own retinue, or a large monster from the Monstrous Host (choose the monster there); neither adds to his own points.

entries.name: Chaos Sorcerer
entries.equipmentText: Sword or other hand weapon

groupLabels.mark: No Mark (choose Unaligned for free Chaos armour)

entries.notes: The Mark costs nothing for a Sorcerer. One spell per magic level, of his god or Dark Magic. May ride a chariot of his retinue or a large monster.

entries.name: Chaos Battle Standard Bearer
entries.equipmentText: Sword, axe, club or other hand weapon; battle standard
entries.notes: Only if the General is a Champion of Chaos or Chaos Sorcerer; cannot be the General. His Mark, if any, should be that of the General's god. He leads his own retinue like any Warlord.

entries.name: Chaos Knights
entries.equipmentText: Heavy armour, shield, lance, sword; barded Chaos Steed

options.name: Chaos armour instead of heavy armour

entries.notes: Standard bearer and musician cost the same as an ordinary Knight. May carry the magic standard of their Warlord's god.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

entries.name: Chaos Warriors
entries.equipmentText: Heavy armour, sword or other hand weapon

options.name: Chaos armour instead of heavy armour

entries.notes: Standard bearer and musician cost the same as an ordinary Warrior.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

entries.name: Chaos Hounds
entries.equipmentText: None
entries.notes: The handler wears heavy armour and carries a hand weapon; he may take one extra weapon.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

entries.name: Chaos Chariots (Chaos Warrior crew)
entries.equipmentText: Crew: heavy armour, swords; barded Chaos Steeds

options.name: Crew Chaos armour instead of heavy

entries.notes: A Warlord of this retinue may ride a chariot, replacing a crewman; his daemonic steeds, if any, are paid on the Warlord. One chariot in the retinue may carry a magic standard.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

requiresSibling.message: a retinue may only include chariots if it has a unit of Chaos Warriors, Chaos Knights, Marauders or Marauder Horsemen (p.104).

entries.name: Chaos Chariots (Marauder crew)
entries.equipmentText: Crew: swords or other hand weapons; warhorses
entries.notes: A Warlord of this retinue may ride a chariot, replacing a crewman. One chariot in the retinue may carry a magic standard.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

requiresSibling.message: a retinue may only include chariots if it has a unit of Chaos Warriors, Chaos Knights, Marauders or Marauder Horsemen (p.104).

entries.name: Chaos Marauders
entries.equipmentText: Swords, axes or other hand weapons
entries.notes: The leader is equipped like his unit at the same cost. Only one unit of Marauders may carry a magic standard.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

entries.name: Marauder Horsemen
entries.equipmentText: Light armour, sword or other hand weapon; warhorse
entries.notes: The Chaos Knight leader costs 50 including his Chaos Steed and light armour; his flail or shield is priced at the equipment list cost.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

entries.name: Ogres
entries.equipmentText: Swords, axes or other hand weapons
entries.notes: One unit of Ogres per retinue, and only if the retinue has Chaos Warriors, Knights, Marauders or Marauder Horsemen. Units may be smaller than five.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

requiresSibling.message: a retinue may only include Ogres if it has a unit of Chaos Warriors, Chaos Knights, Marauders or Marauder Horsemen (p.105).

entries.name: Beastman Chieftain
entries.equipmentText: Sword, axe, club or other hand weapon
entries.notes: Magic items from Warhammer Magic. May ride a chariot of his retinue.

entries.name: Beastman Shaman
entries.equipmentText: Sword, axe, club or other hand weapon; no armour
entries.notes: Spells from any of the Chaos decks, or Dark Magic. May ride a chariot of his retinue.

entries.name: Beastman Battle Standard Bearer
entries.equipmentText: Sword, axe, club or other hand weapon; battle standard
entries.notes: Only if the General is a Beastman Chieftain or Shaman; cannot be the General. May carry a magic standard of one of the Chaos gods. He leads his own retinue like any Warlord.

entries.name: Beastman Gors
entries.equipmentText: Swords or other hand weapons

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

entries.name: Beastman Ungors
entries.equipmentText: Clubs or other crude hand weapons
entries.notes: The Champion pays the full equipment cost (spear +1, shield +1). One Ungor unit in the army may skirmish (then it is not affected by infighting).

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

entries.name: Bestigors
entries.equipmentText: Halberds, heavy armour
entries.rulesText: Immune to infighting, No panic from Ungors
entries.notes: Only one unit of Bestigors in the army. The Champion's 65 points include his halberd and heavy armour.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

entries.name: Beastman Chariots
entries.equipmentText: Crew: swords; pulled by two Tuskgors
entries.notes: A Warlord of this retinue may ride a chariot, replacing a crewman. One chariot may carry a magic standard.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

requiresSibling.message: a retinue may only include chariots if it has a unit of Gors, Ungors or Bestigors (p.109).

entries.name: Minotaurs
entries.equipmentText: Swords, axes, clubs or other hand weapons
entries.notes: One unit of Minotaurs per retinue, and only if the retinue has Gors, Ungors or Bestigors. Units may be smaller than five.

attachTo.label: Retinue of
attachTo.requiredMessage: must be part of a Warlord's retinue (choose a Warlord)

requiresSibling.message: a retinue may only include Minotaurs if it has a unit of Gors, Ungors or Bestigors (p.110).

entries.name: Chaos Hounds (Beastman)
entries.equipmentText: None
entries.notes: The Beastman Champion may take one extra weapon, a shield, and light or heavy armour.

attachTo.label: Retinue of

entries.name: Greater Daemon
entries.equipmentText: None needed (often a sword, axe or other weapon)
entries.notes: Up to two Daemonic Rewards. Only Daemons of his own god may join his retinue. An army led by a Chaos Warrior or Beastman Warlord may summon one Greater Daemon as an ally without a retinue (p.112).

entries.name: Daemon Prince
entries.equipmentText: Sword or other hand weapon
entries.notes: Up to two Daemonic Rewards. With a Mark, only Daemons of that god may join his retinue; unaligned Princes may take any.

entries.name: Daemon Battle Standard Bearer

attachTo.label: Leads
attachTo.requiredMessage: must lead a unit of Bloodletters, Plaguebearers, Pink Horrors or Daemonettes in the General's retinue

entries.notes: Replaces the unit's normal leader. Rides his god's steed if his unit does. His magic standard must be the War Banner of his god (Realm of Chaos card: add it as a custom item).

entries.name: Chaos Spawn
entries.notes: Up to five Spawn form a single unit, six to ten one or two units, and so on.
